full_description:
As aPricing Expert, you will join an established Pricing Department and play a key role in defining and implementing pricing strategies forING corporate clientsacross a range of products and services. These include core daily banking solutions such asaccounts, payments, channels, and cash management.
You will work closely withsales teams, product managers, and other stakeholdersto ensure competitive pricing while maximizing profitability for each opportunity.
Review customer requirements with Sales teams and select the appropriate pricing methodology.
Develop pricing proposals that optimize profitability within ING’s product framework.
Ensure all necessary approvals are obtained prior to sign-off.
Perform financial modeling inMS Excel, applying cost adjustments where needed.
Maintain compliance with internal guidelines and international legal standards.
Drive innovation in pricing processes by introducing new ideas and automation.
Insure systems are up to date with the latest pricing including our web portal i.e tariff brochures
Build strong relationships with Sales teams, Product Managers, and colleagues across multiple countries.
Act as a trusted advisor on pricing matters and support strategic decision-making.
Manage day-to-day pricing activities, including preparing and validating pricing proposals.
